# Binding Wire Machine - Industrial Machinery Manufacturer & Exporter

> Leading manufacturer of automatic wire nail making machinery, continuous wire drawing lines, and binding wire plants located in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## Company Information
- Brand: Binding Wire Machine (Alternate: Indian Nail Machine)
- Proprietor: Yasin Ahamed Sandhi
- Factory Location: Aji Industrial Area, Phase-2, Shed No. 123, Rajkot, Gujarat - 360003, India
- Coordinates: 22.2858° N, 70.7997° E
- Direct Contact & WhatsApp: +91 99788 22099
- Email: info@bindingwiremachine.com | bindingwiremachinery@gmail.com
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015

## Machinery Portfolio
1. **IN Series Wire Nail Making Machines**: Models IN1+, IN3, IN4, IN6. Speeds from 150 to 550 nails/min. Output nail length: 1" to 6".
2. **Continuous Wire Drawing Plants (WDM-600)**: Multi-die reduction plants for MS, HB, and high-carbon steel rod processing.
3. **Automatic Binding Wire Making Plants (BWM-300)**: Integrated wire drawing, pit annealing furnaces, and spooling systems.
4. **Tooling & Auxiliary**: Tumbling polishing barrel drums and precision cutter die grinders.
